controlledVariables: One source DLL, settings digest, dependency snapshot, and completed all-on Info cache
One SteamVR null-HMD lane, save, cell, weather, position, and static camera
Thirty-eight unique resolved frames with zero slot refusals
deviations: The return added explicit queued-mutation settling, scene-time verification, and post-arm sample filtering.
It occurred after the counterfactual runs and method-correction attempts.
The original baseline did not retain start/end scene snapshots in its raw profiler artifact.

reasons: CSX used Info logging and the unchanged completed all-on disk cache without compilation overlapping samples.
The scene and time reset were verified after the settle barrier.
All 38 retained frames were unique, resolved, newer than the arming boundary, and reported zero slot refusals.
Exact settings, raw profiler output, cache identity, runtime, scene, and hardware are retained.

conclusions: The all-on return averaged 5.2335 ms versus 5.0943 ms in the original all-on baseline, a +0.1392 ms shift.
Upscaling::Upscale moved from 4.0735 ms to 4.3237 ms, a +0.2502 ms shift that is unrelated to the IBL or Volumetric Shadows toggles and dominates the campaign's small candidate differences.
The observed all-on drift exceeds both one-variable top-level differences, so neither marginal feature cost is resolved by a single 38-frame pass.
Future preset decisions require longer balanced blocks or repeated A/B/A sequences; the current observations should inform their sample-size design.
notes: The accepted three-run time windows began within 0.00015 game hours and ended within 0.00064 game hours of one another.
The original all-on cache remains selected in the isolated test profile after restoration.
No ShaderCache overwrite overlay remained after the campaign.
